title: loki.yaml
description: One config file for the Loki UI and the headless CLI (D51). Looked up in the repo root, then ~/.loki/loki.yaml (first found wins, no merging). Precedence: CLI flag > environment > loki.yaml > default. Secrets are never stored here: every credential key holds the NAME of an environment variable.

token_env.description: NAME of the env var holding a GitHub PAT (never the token). Env override: LOKI_GIT_TOKEN_ENV.

repos.description: owner/repo list the UI offers and headless runs may target.

concurrency.description: Max backlog runs in parallel (default 2). Env override: LOKI_BACKLOG_CONCURRENCY.

per_run_usd.description: USD cap forwarded to each run as LOKI_BUDGET_LIMIT. Env override: LOKI_BUDGET_PER_RUN_USD.

per_day_usd.description: USD per calendar day; backlog stops launching new runs once reached (BUDGET_STOP). Env override: LOKI_BUDGET_PER_DAY_USD.

knowledge_sources.description: Local paths of knowledge to give runs. Parsed and validated only; consumed by a later slice.

slack_webhook_env.description: NAME of the env var holding the Slack webhook URL (never the URL). Env override: LOKI_SLACK_WEBHOOK_ENV.
